title: HDF Plan
description: Defines an assessment plan — what baselines to run against which targets, with resolved inputs and scheduling. Maps to OSCAL Assessment Plan.

planId.description: Unique identifier for this plan. Optional in casual use, expected in production documents. Auto-generated if omitted during creation.

name.description: Human-readable plan name. Example: 'Portal Monthly Assessment'.

description.description: Description of the plan's purpose and scope.

systemRef.description: URI to the hdf-system document this plan targets. Example: 'portal-prod.hdf-system.json'.

assessments.description: The assessments to perform. Each assessment pairs a baseline with targets and resolved inputs.

schedule.description: Optional scheduling configuration for recurring assessments.

labels.description: Optional key-value labels for grouping and querying plans.

integrity.description: Cryptographic integrity information for verifying this plan document has not been tampered with.

generator.description: Information about the tool that generated this plan.
